description: Get one web tracking key with its install snippet and ingest endpoint. Use this to hand a developer the exact `<script>` tag to paste, rather than reconstructing it - the snippet embeds both the publishable key and the workspace id, and a hand-built one that gets either wrong fails silently.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

id.description: Web tracking key ID from list_web_tracking_keys.

name: get_web_tracking_key

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_web_tracking_key` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

key.description: The key, including the paste-ready installSnippet and the ingest endpoint.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
